checkRuns.command:
sed -i "s/^      |$/      {' '}/; s/^        |$/        {' '}/" src/components/book-list.kay && bun run fmt && grep -n "{' '}" src/components/book-list.kay && bun run check && bun run build >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $?
PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2; for u in / /books /books/frankenstein /books/nope /about /contact /zzz; do echo "== $u $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' localhost:4701$u)"; done

pkill -f "kay start"; sleep 1; bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -2 && bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -E "error|warn" ; echo build=$?
PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &
sleep 2; for u in / /books /books/dracula /about /contact /x; do echo "$u $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 127.0.0.1:4702$u)"; done; pkill -f "kay start"; sleep 1; pgrep -fa "kay start" || echo stopped; cat /tmp/srv.log; git status --short

bun run fmt 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -1 && bun run build > /tmp/build.log 2>&1; echo build=$?; grep -i -E "error|warn" /tmp/build.log
PORT=4702 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4702 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &
SRV=$!; sleep 2; for u in / /books /books/dracula /about /contact /x; do echo "$u $(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 127.0.0.1:4702$u)"; done
kill $SRV; sleep 1; ss -ltn | grep 4702 || echo stopped; cat /tmp/srv.log; git status --short
